scope: Track B screens: Login, Setup, Privacy, Terms, 404, Khata, Orders (sales, purchase, what-if), Inventory (raw, finished, recipes, movements), Settings, the payment dialog and the party drawer
method: e2e/audit-controls.mjs clicks every control on a fresh page load; e2e/regression-trackB.mjs runs the user journeys (cancel and confirm for destructive steps); audit-a11y.mjs and audit-keyboard.mjs check accessibility, layout and focus
statuses: PASS = acted, effect observed, no console/page/HTTP error; FAIL = error or no observable effect; BLOCKED = destructive or external, covered by a journey; NOT APPLICABLE = disabled or hidden in that state

checks.name: payment amount "1e5" (exponent) is refused with Save disabled
payment amount "0x10" (hex) is refused with Save disabled
payment amount "12.345" (three decimals) is refused with Save disabled
payment amount "-5" (negative) is refused with Save disabled
payment amount "abc" (letters) is refused with Save disabled
payment amount "0" (zero) is refused with Save disabled
payment amount "" (empty) is refused with Save disabled
payment amount "99999999999999" (too large) is refused with Save disabled
payment amount shows an explanation under the field
a valid cheque is saved as pending and the dialog closes after one click even if double-clicked
Escape closes the payment dialog and focus returns to the button that opened it
Tab stays inside the open dialog (focus trap)
first pending cheque for the whole bill is accepted
a second cheque for the same bill is refused on screen with a plain sentence
ledger shows Cleared and Bounced buttons on the pending cheque
Bounced removes the buttons and the cash does not change
after a bounce the same bill can be paid again
credit days "abc" and "400" show a message and disable Add
a name with markup is stored and shown as text, never run
reopening Add customer starts empty (no stale values)
the party drawer opens from a row and closes with Escape
the reminder composer drafts a message and never sends
company and party datasheets download as CSV with a BOM-free readable header
stage buttons are disabled while one is working (no double move)
Undo asks first; Keep as is changes nothing
Undo confirm moves the order back and the books checks still pass
"Can I take this order?" refuses text in quantity and price with a message
a purchase order can be created, received and undone, and stock follows
new material: an empty name is refused with a message and nothing is created
new material: cost "1e3", opening stock with too many decimals are refused
search and status filters narrow the list and clearing restores it
stock adjustment needs a note
Recipes tab opens a recipe and Movements lists entries
every settings section renders
safety buffer: negative, text and 3 decimals are refused
invite: bad email and empty name keep Invite disabled; a good one shows the temporary password once
inviting the same email again says it cannot be invited (no account hints)
Remove asks twice; waiting disarms it and nothing is removed
Reset business stays disabled until the exact name is typed; cancel leaves the data
Reset business with the right name empties the sandbox and the app still loads
an empty business shows helpful empty states on Khata, Orders, Inventory, Book
Load demo data restores it after a confirm click
setup: with no AI key, a description gives a plain message and keeps the text
setup: Load the demo business asks before replacing records, and Keep stops it
cookie notice shows on login, links to privacy and stays dismissed
Privacy and Terms are linked from login, have headings and a way back
an unknown address shows the 404 page with a way home
the sign-in form rejects an empty submit, a wrong password shows one clear message
the password eye button is reachable by keyboard
UI in hi: no raw translation keys, no horizontal overflow on Today, Khata, Settings at 390 px
UI in ta: no raw translation keys, no horizontal overflow on Today, Khata, Settings at 390 px
number format and text size preferences do not break Today
supervisor: lands on Orders, sees no rupee sign anywhere on Orders and Inventory
supervisor typing a finance address gets sent home, not an error
supervisor cannot reach the shared demo team or data actions
a raw material can be added, edited and deleted from the screen
a stock adjustment with a note changes on-hand once and shows in Movements
negative stock cannot be created by an adjustment
GSTIN: a malformed number is refused, a valid one saves, the profile reloads with it
recurring expense: add, shows in the list, remove with the second click
forecast horizon change recalculates and Today still renders
display preferences (theme, text size) apply to the page and survive a reload
Log out ends the session, lands on sign-in and the app is closed to the old cookie
Log out everywhere ends every session of the user, not only this one
a signed-out visitor who opens an app address is sent to sign-in
